title: census.py head_cited_lines raises on a cat-file missing line, and the dispatch docstrings still say a session reads only the group's files
goal: head_cited_lines parses the cat-file --batch output inside the try that falls back to kbfacts.cited_lines, so a missing blob falls back instead of raising IndexError; the module and dispatch_rules docstrings say the session also reads every clone under _cache/census/repos through --add-dir

run: import sys,inspect;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import census;s=inspect.getsource(census.head_cited_lines);i=s.find('try:');j=s.find('split()[2]');sys.exit(0 if (i>=0 and j>i and 'except' in s[j:]) else 1)

repro_reason: a missing blob needs a ref whose tree names a blob the object store lacks, which a planted repository can build but a one-line command cannot; the repro reads where the parse sits relative to its try
